scope: Independent local replay of the repository's published verification script. It verifies those symbolic and discretization checks execute with the pinned code. It does not reproduce the complete OpenAI force-pulse construction, establish the continuum theorem, validate all published parameter sweeps, or test molecular particle alignment.
limitations: The source's raw parameter-sweep and cluster outputs were not independently reproduced.
The heat-exterior test shows decreasing discrete residual but does not provide a rigorous error bound for the full profile problem.
The manufactured-solution test compares the discrete operator to the symbolic residual for its chosen smooth profiles; it does not prove correctness for all profiles or boundary treatments.
The tested model is a leading-order similarity system, not the full finite-viscosity forced Navier-Stokes evolution.
